snippet.title: Laser Dance - Early Access Announcement
snippet.description:
LASER DANCE is a mixed reality game that turns your living room into a laser obstacle course. Dance, dodge, and crawl your way to victory in this intuitive party game that's perfect for both newcomers and seasoned gamers!

Coming in Early Access to Meta Quest 3/3s in fall 2025.
